1981-3188-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-3188-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3480-3755-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2981-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2981-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

586-864-3125-5256-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5256-5632.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

215-539-1597-7781.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Gyre Sage
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1456-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat

240-997-1849-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

4785-7014-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
4785-7014-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Dynaheir by tapping it.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting the ability from step 1.
Dynaheir triggers. Holding priority, activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Dynaheir's trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Dynaheir's trigger
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6

328-2438-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2438-5220-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1021-1669-2034-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-1669-2034-6761.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-1669-2034-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

1477-2558-5687-5688.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

3558-4452-5852.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
3558-4452-5852.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Crookshank Kobolds triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Crookshank Kobolds spells, causing the nontoken Crookshank Kobolds to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

3693-4613-4651-5506.notablePrerequisites:
Withengar Unbound does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Withengar Unbound, or cannot prevent at least ten trample damage from Withengar Unbound.
Walking Ballista exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
3693-4613-4651-5506.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Withengar Unbound, causing them to get at least ten poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Withengar Unbound triggers, putting thirteen +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Withengar Unbound using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving an opponent a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until the opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Repeat from step 3.

224-2532-2653-3201.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
224-2532-2653-3201.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Arixmethes.
Put the token Arixmethes into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Arixmethes token dies, causing you to draw a card.
The Arixmethes token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat.

1624-2997-3646-4827.manaNeeded: {8}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-2997-3646-4827.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Strovald by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving Evra base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Evra by paying {4}, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1029-2784-5042.notablePrerequisites:
Alaundo does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {2} mana.
1029-2784-5042.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Alaundo by tapping it, drawing two cards and exiling a card from your hand, and removing a time counter from all other cards previously exiled with this ability.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {2}, untapping Alaundo and the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.

147-4499-4739.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
147-4499-4739.description:
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {1}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Battle Hymn.
Resolve the copy of Battle Hymn, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1447-4050-4875.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Glory's Rise, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, then returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
